plain: West Norfolk Council says it contained an attempted cyber attack picked up late on Monday and has started an investigation. It says there is no current indication any data was accessed.
summary: Lynn News reports that West Norfolk Council's monitoring picked up an attempted cyber attack late on Monday and IT staff worked until the early hours of Tuesday. The council says the attack was successfully contained, that there is no current indication any data was accessed, and that it is conducting a full investigation. The paper describes it as the second attempt in four months, after an attack in July.
title: West Norfolk Council says it contained a second attempted cyber attack in four months and is investigating

validation.note: Single publisher (Lynn News) quoting the council's own statement.
